_doc: Token -> MG (Merch Group) mapping used by deterministic_pipeline.py Stage 1. Tokens are matched case-insensitively as whole words. Policy: UNISEX -> K-Footwear (kids) for now; revisit when a doc mixes unisex with M and W.
_emit_note: field_value.value carries the matched token in uppercase (MENS / WMNS / KIDS / UNISEX); phase5/populate.py normalize_gender maps those into the Excel MG dropdown vocabulary (M-Footwear / W-Footwear / K-Footwear).

description_prefix._doc: Single-letter prefixes seen at the START of a product description line, separated by whitespace (e.g. 'W AIR FORCE 1 NA' -> W). Matched only when followed by a space.

description_suffix._doc: Single-letter or token at the END of a product description (e.g. 'JABBAR HI W' -> W). Industry convention across major footwear vendors. Matched as a whole word at end-of-string, so internal Ws (e.g. 'BROWN') don't trip it.

canonical_value._doc: What we write into field_value.value for the gender field.
